::: {.callout-note title="Question"}

Explain attribute `members`  in the next chunk.

Hint: Nodes are identified by their *prefix order index*. 

:::

```{r}
dend |>  
  get_nodes_attr("members", 
                 id = c(1, 2, 5, 7)) 
```


::: {.callout-tip title="Solution"}

The dendrogram is traversed using depth-first-search. For each node, attribute `members` is the number of leaves 
in the subtree rooted at that node. 

We start form the root with 5 leaves/members, then proceed to left child with 2 leaves/members .... 

:::







::: {.callout-note title="Question"}

- What does `labels()` return?
- What does function `rotate` do ?

:::

```{r}
dend |>  labels()

dend |> 
  rotate(c(1,2,4,5,3)) |> 
  plot()
```


::: {.callout-tip title="Solution"}

`labels()` returns leaves labels ordered by depth-first-search tarversal.

:::

::: {.callout-note type="Question"}

What is the *height* of a branch?

Just look at what happens when `hclust` uses method `ward.D2`

:::  


::: {.callout-tip title="Solution"}

```{r}
hc9 <- 1:9  |>  
  dist()  |>  
  hclust(method="ward.D2")

hc9$height

dend9 <- as.dendrogram(hc9)

dend9 |>  
  plot()
#get_branches_heights(dend9)

hc9$height^2
```

This is consistent with the `ward.D2` clost  for merging clusters with $n_A, n_B$ elements and centroids $\mu_A, \mu_B$

$$\left(2 \frac{n_An_B}{n_A+n_B} \|\mu_A - \mu_B\|^2\right)^{1/2}$$

:::

# Iris

```{r}
dist_iris <- iris |> 
  select(where(is.numeric)) |> 
  dist() 

hcl_iris <- dist_iris |> 
  hclust(method = "ward.D2") 

dendro_iris <- as.dendrogram(hcl_iris)
```

```{r}
hcl_iris |>  
  plot()
```

```{r}
cl_iris_3 <- cutree(hcl_iris, k=3)
iris$cluster <- factor(cl_iris_3)
```

```{r}
pca_iris <- iris |> 
  select(where(is.numeric)) |> 
  scale() |> 
  prcomp() 

pca_iris_aug <- augment(pca_iris, iris)
```

```{r}
pca_iris_aug |> 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x=.fittedPC1, y=.fittedPC2, color=Species, shape=cluster, label=.rownames) +
  geom_point() +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel() +
  coord_fixed()
```

```{r}
autoplot(pca_iris, data=iris, loadings=T, loadings.labels=T) +
  geom_point(aes(color=Species, shape=cluster)) +
  coord_fixed()
```

```{r}

prep_co_circle <- function(pco) {
  r <- with(pco,  t(t(rotation) * sdev[1:ncol(rotation)]))
  as_tibble(r) |> 
    rename_with(.fn = \(x) gsub('PC', '', x), .cols=everything()) |>
    mutate(row_id=rownames(r))
}
```



```{r}

  temp_pca |> 
  prep_co_circle() |> 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x=`1`, y=`2`, label=row_id) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(xend=0, yend=0), 
    arrow = grid::arrow(ends = "first")) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel() +
  coord_fixed() +
  xlim(c(-1.1, 1.1)) + ylim(c(-1.1, 1.1))  + 
  ggforce::geom_circle(aes(x0=0, y0=0, r=1), linetype="dashed") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
plot_prcomp <- function (object, 
  data = NULL, 
  scale = 1, 
  x = 1, y = 2, 
  variance_percentage = TRUE, 
  ...) 
{
    plot.data <- ggplot2::fortify(object, data = data)  # semblable au augment(object, data)
    plot.data$rownames <- rownames(plot.data)           # ajout d'une colonne de noms
        ve <- object$sdev^2/sum(object$sdev^2)          # part de variance projete sur les PCs
        PC <- paste0("PC", c(x, y))
        x.column <- PC[1]              # nom premiere PC 
        y.column <- PC[2]              # nom deuxieme PC
        loadings.column <- "rotation"    # 
        lam <- object$sdev[c(x, y)]      # valeurs singulieres 
        lam <- lam * sqrt(nrow(plot.data))   # 
    if (scale != 0) {
        lam <- lam^scale
        plot.data[, c(x.column, y.column)] <- t(t(plot.data[, 
            c(x.column, y.column)])/lam)    # scale=1 revient à choisir l'element U dans la svd
    }
    plot.columns <- unique(c(x.column, y.column, colnames(plot.data)))
    plot.data <- plot.data[, plot.columns]  # reordonne les colonnes, met x.column, y.column en tête
    if (!is.null(loadings.column)) {
        loadings.data <- as.data.frame(object[[loadings.column]][, 
            ])
        loadings.data[, c(x, y)] <- t(t(loadings.data[, c(x, y)]) * lam[c(x, y)])
        loadings.data$rownames <- rownames(loadings.data)
        loadings.columns <- unique(c(x.column, y.column, colnames(loadings.data)))
        loadings.data <- loadings.data[, loadings.columns]
    }
    else {
        loadings.data <- NULL
    }
    if (is.null(ve) | !variance_percentage) {
        labs <- PC
    }
    else {
        ve <- ve[c(x, y)]
        labs <- paste0(PC, " (", round(ve * 100, 2), "%)")
    }
    xlab <- labs[1]
    ylab <- labs[2]
    p <- ggfortify::ggbiplot(plot.data = plot.data, 
                  loadings.data = loadings.data, 
                  xlab = xlab, 
                  ylab = ylab, 
                  ...)   # transmission d'arguments supplémentaires 
    return(p)
}
```


```{r}
neat_color_scale <-
      c("1" = "#01d4e5",
        "2" = "#c3ea01ff" ,
        "3" = "#fc5173",
        "4" = "#0fdc1dff")
```


```{r}
temperature$cluster = factor(cutree(temp_hclust, k=3))

bp1 <- temp_pca |>
  plot_prcomp(data=temperature,
              loadings=T,
              loadings.labels=T,
              labels=T) + 
  coord_fixed() +
  scale_color_manual(values=neat_color_scale) +
  theme_minimal(    
  ) +
  ggforce::geom_circle(aes(x0=0,y0=0, r=.28), linetype="dotted") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label=City, color=cluster), show.legend = FALSE)

```
